review_description: Many companies did not respond with a full quote, but used this to meet one on one to pressure the sale, which did not happen. Pricing was not fully disclosed, detailing exactly what you were paying for.After reading and comparing many quotes, most were incomplete, not offering answers to many of the basic questions as to price structure and services, particularly after service support. It is a difficult indusrty to deal with as there are many ways to cut prices through inferior products.
